findings.title: B37/M28 have no legal RemediationObligation creation transaction
findings.requirement: An exhausted BUILD or MAINTENANCE rollback must atomically create the protected rollback-safety RemediationObligation through an exact legal aggregate transaction; prose cannot invent an edge.
evidence: B37 and M28 require atomic creation of the obligation when Work enters ROLLBACK_REMEDIATION_WAIT.
The closed RemediationObligation table has only RO01/RO02 for non-revoking absent-to-OPEN creation, and both require a C11 signal.
C11 is an outgoing signal row from a terminal ESCALATED_DISPOSITION CleanupItem, while §13 explicitly says the B37/M28 rollback-safety subject does not create a CleanupItem.
No row authorizes B37 or M28 as the creation trigger, and the manifest forbids prose or inferred transitions from adding one.
findings.impact: A literal compiler must either reject B37/M28 because their required cross-aggregate mutation has no legal RemediationObligation edge, or invent an unlisted creation path. The failed rollback can therefore strand without the protected obligation that supplies remediation, revocation, and closure safety.
findings.required_correction: Add exact absent-to-OPEN rollback-safety creation row(s), or broaden a named creation row with a closed purpose/trigger partition that explicitly includes B37 and M28. Define the atomic Work/obligation/link/child/event/receipt CAS, replay behavior, generation rule, and authority. Add witnesses proving B37/M28 use only that row and conflict/replay safely.

findings.title: RO09 releases remediation resource blocks before rollback verification seals
findings.requirement: Exposure and resource-reuse blocks created for an exhausted failed rollback must remain until genuine restoration is independently verified and the parent reaches ROLLBACK_VERIFIED/ROLLED_BACK.
evidence: RO09 closes the obligation and says bound resource blocks may be removed atomically at that transition.
B74/M62 are later rows: they require the already-CLOSED obligation and only fresh independent verification authority, then enter ROLLBACK_VERIFYING.
B34/M25 perform the later known-good verification, and B38/M29 later seal ROLLED_BACK.
B74/M62 simultaneously claim to preserve exposure/resource blocks until verification seals, which contradicts RO09's earlier block removal permission and PLAN §13's release-at-CLOSED rule.
findings.impact: A conforming implementation may release or reuse protected resources in the RO09-to-B34/M25 window even though rollback is not yet independently verified. The alternative interpretation that retains them violates the explicit RO09/PLAN release contract. This is an unsafe ordering contradiction in the round-10 repair.
findings.required_correction: Separate remediation-child closure from release of the rollback-safety resource blocks. Keep the blocks through B74/M62 and B34/M25, and remove them only atomically with a named verified/rolled-back transition after the genuine restoration receipt and independent verification result pass. Align PLAN §13, RO09, B74/M62, and the BUILD/MAINTENANCE witnesses.
